verdict.rationale: jev-supp-versioning explicitly documents versioned IDs (jev-1.13.0) with aliases (jev-latest, jev-preview) resolving to them, plus explicit guidance to pin a version if thresholds are tuned, and the response echoes the resolved versioned ID. jev-supp-models-endpoint and jev-docs-30/33 corroborate model discovery and selection via the API. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on confirmation that pinned versions remain stable over time or a deprecation timeline policy for old pinned versions.
